title: Word: legal plugin for Copilot adds legal skills to Word desktop
summary: Hold: restarting Word does not guarantee that a newly changed policy has reached the device, because Cloud Policy retrieves settings on a check-in interval. The roadmap facts, commercial default, licensing entitlement and documented policy route are otherwise supported; the claim about open documents and two governance presentation gaps also need correction.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: A change to the policy reaches users on their next restart.

claims.fix: Replace the Change & support bullet with 'Cloud Policy settings take effect when the Office app is restarted after the device has retrieved the applicable settings.
